title: 4-bit boolean function f=Σ(4,5,7,12,13,15) (process+if with to_unsigned literals)
problemDescription: Boolean function f(a,b,c,d) = 1 iff abcd ∈ {0100, 0101, 0111, 1100, 1101, 1111}, else 0. Reference uses `to_unsigned(N, abcd'length)` integer-to-vector conversions inside the IF comparison — exercises Kmila's numeric_std conversion path differently from case 007.
